final: WITH rating_avgs AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) as avg_length FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) as baseline_val FROM rating_avgs), above_baseline AS (SELECT rating, avg_length FROM rating_avgs WHERE avg_length > (SELECT baseline_val FROM baseline)), secondary_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) as secondary_mean FROM above_baseline), final_set AS (SELECT rating, avg_length FROM above_baseline WHERE avg_length > (SELECT secondary_mean FROM secondary_mean)) SELECT AVG(avg_length) as mean_of_remaining, AVG(avg_length - (SELECT baseline_val FROM baseline)) as mean_excess_baseline, AVG(avg_length - (SELECT secondary_mean FROM secondary_mean)) as mean_excess_secondary FROM final_set
